title: Writes that bypass Django mutations (no events/activity log)
answers: Why didn't an issue change emit a lifecycle event?
body:
Paths that skip activity log and/or lifecycle events:
- bulk_update_issues status uses QuerySet.update() (skips save()); passes opener_allowed=False to lifecycle events.
- Temporal auto-merge: EB/temporal/fingerprint_embedding_result/activities.py:_merge_fingerprint_into_closest_issue (gated by ERROR_TRACKING_AUTO_MERGE_ENABLED) writes no activity log, emits no event.
- Cymbal (rust/cymbal/src/modes/processing/issue_resolution.rs) inserts and reopens issues directly in Postgres.
- Also EB/logic/github_external_references.py and management command backfill_error_tracking_issue_legacy_statuses.
- ClickHouse sync: sync_issues_to_clickhouse version is ms timestamp, must match cymbal FingerprintIssueState::new.
applies: When adding logic that must react to every issue change; user API paths through issue_mutations.py are covered, these are not.
